genre.label: MountainNoir / MontañaNoir atmospheric cinematic folk, trip-hop and dark ambient long-form
genre.user_declaration: Build a new YouTube long-form MountainNoir living-painting film from the four Drive masters, using raw source imagery and looped effects rather than completed videos.

rhythm.pulse_description: This is a continuous compilation of independently measured songs, so there is no single honest global BPM. Scene motion follows each chapter's measured energy, onset, and reactive-control artifacts while the three joins use restrained equal-power overlaps.
rhythm.meter_or_groove: Irish Eyes 89.1029 BPM estimate; Leave It by the Door 161.499 BPM estimate; Silver Coin 86.1328 BPM estimate; El Viento instrumental 92.2852 BPM estimate. The global film uses phrase-level pacing rather than a fabricated common grid.

sequence_rule: Irish Eyes, Leave It by the Door, and Silver Coin play back to back with three-second equal-power overlaps. El Viento instrumental is last and owns the final extension. No standalone interludes, silence padding, added ambience, or additional songs are permitted.
